fields.statement: QA with a fresh build in a scratch root (fake rex running the child in the background): rhiza run spawn --no-wait returned at once with rc 0, session, brief and no_wait:true, no outcome; journal spawn entry no_wait:true, spawn-ended only when the child ended. Missing brief rc 2, failed rex start rc 1 with no spawn entry; the default waiting spawn unchanged (pass (exit 0), no no_wait, no wake). Scoped tests TestRunSpawn, TestSpawn|TestFold, TestScripts/(run-spawn|describe-golden) pass.

QA with a fresh build: two no-wait children (exit 1, said done) each got one spawn-ended entry and one wake; the parent's message file names child, role, leaf, outcome, detail and rhiza run status --json; the said-done child's pane closed, the exited child's left open. A working parent got both pointers queued at once; an exited or prompt-less parent's wake failure was logged, not retried, and the run succeeded. A waiting child's end woke no one. TestSpawnWake, TestSpawnResume, TestRunSpawnWake pass.

QA with a fresh build: rhiza guide conduct tells the conductor to spawn with --no-wait, start independent children together, end its turn without sleep or poll and act on each wake-up via rhiza run status --json, keeping the never sleep/poll rule; rhiza guide conduct-roles documents --no-wait, the wake message and the waiting default for other callers. internal/guide tests, TestDocsPrimitives and TestScripts/guide-install pass.
